metadata.title: An isoperimetric problem for Fourier zeros of centrally symmetric convex bodies
metadata.abstract: Given a centrally symmetric convex body, consider the zero set of the Fourier transform of its characteristic function. We study how large the distance from this set to the origin can be when the volume of the body is fixed. A 2009 conjecture of Benguria, Levitin, and Parnovski asserts that the maximum is attained by a Euclidean ball. We disprove it in all dimensions greater than one. In the plane, every regular centrally symmetric polygon with at least twelve sides outperforms the disk, albeit by a tiny margin, and the regular dodecagon is best among them. In dimensions three and higher, no maximiser exists.

analysis.workSummary: 声称否定固定体积中心对称凸体 Fourier 首零距离由球极大的猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 平面给出优于圆盘的正多边形；正文推论 1.3 更证明高维固定体积下该量的上确界为无穷。
analysis.limitations: 平面优势很小，须核对严谨误差控制。高维不只是未达到极大值，正文给出无界性；当前已补读主结果，未逐行验证构造。
analysis.aiEvidence: 用 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 建议证明策略并辅助计算。
analysis.priorityReason: 明确凸几何谱型猜想的反例，值得检查构造与估计。
